elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 5.5 gives the Company all right, title and interest in all deliverables and work product created by HDI for the Company.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly “hereby assigns all such right, title and interest” to the Company.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: HDI retains ownership of its pre-existing software, systems, tools and know-how.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The licence to HDI materials incorporated in the Site or any deliverable is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The licence to incorporated HDI materials is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The licence to incorporated HDI materials is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The Company owns all right, title and interest in the defined Company Data.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: The clause does not impose this processing-only limitation and carves out unspecified licences granted under Sections 6.1 and 7.1, so the absence of a Vendor licence in Company Data is not demonstrably established.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: Section 5.5 expressly states that nothing in the Agreement creates joint ownership.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly retains its pre-existing tools and know-how.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the deliverables outright, while any incorporated HDI materials are covered by an express perpetual licence.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the deliverables outright, while any incorporated HDI materials are covered by an express irrevocable licence.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the deliverables outright, while any incorporated HDI materials are covered by an express worldwide licence.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the deliverables outright, while any incorporated HDI materials are covered by an express royalty-free licence.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the deliverables, and the licence covering incorporated HDI materials expressly permits use and modification without a narrower purpose restriction.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the deliverables, and the licence covering incorporated HDI materials expressly permits sublicensing without a narrower purpose restriction.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: No processing-only limitation is stated, and the carve-out for unspecified licences in Sections 6.1 and 7.1 prevents concluding that no Vendor licence in Company Data exists.
